This re-lock ships the revised 16-page manuscript (hinge-anchored uniqueness, certified exchange bound, at-most-four-hidden-facet corollary), the two-condition E-A58 v3 kernel, the E-A61/E-A63 witness families, the four Theorem 7.6 certificates with their SymPy verification, and corrects the reference cost to O(N^2 log N + k^4).
The two recorded defects of the S107/S108 candidate (pre-repair flat-only certifier; k^3 cost claim) are repaired by this tree.
The archived Singular driver files under certificates/ had their output path neutralized to a relative filename for release; no mathematical content changed.

Five working files carried CRLF endings from Windows text-mode writes; they were normalized to LF and the manifest and all replays were regenerated on the exact normalized bytes, so staged, cloned and verified bytes coincide (the S107 RT-101 control).
Normal and optimized replays passed in the candidate tree and in the isolated 53-file manifest-only tree, all three producing the same receipt bytes.
The present task authorizes a scoped local commit only. No remote, tag, GitHub Release, DOI, arXiv submission or journal submission is created.
